description: Three injection points: SessionStart routes once to the craft skill matching the deliverable's medium and resets the engaged-craft set on a fresh session; UserPromptSubmit re-engages the laws on every user message; PreToolUse on Skill guards craft compatibility, letting compatible crafts coexist but refusing an ordering the policy declares. One hook per event: anything an event injects goes through its one entry, and text over Claude Code's 10,000-character cap on a hook's context is cut down, never spread across more entries. The orderings live in hooks/scripts/incompatible-crafts.txt and are not restated here - a second copy is a second thing to go stale, and the copy is what a reader believes.
